title: fix(ai): count Gemini thinking tokens in output token metrics

files.patch:
@@ -211,7 +211,9 @@ async def prompt(self, messages: tuple[Any, ...]) -> Any:
         if response.usage_metadata:
             self._record_usage_metrics(
                 input_tokens=response.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count or 0,
-                output_tokens=response.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count or 0,
+                # Gemini thinking models report reasoning tokens separately from candidates
+                output_tokens=(response.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count or 0)
+                + (response.usage_metadata.thoughts_token_count or 0),
                 total_tokens=response.usage_metadata.total_token_count or 0,
             )

@@ -261,7 +261,8 @@ async def _test():
             usage = Mock()
             usage.prompt_token_count = 10
             usage.candidates_token_count = 20
-            usage.total_token_count = 30
+            usage.thoughts_token_count = 5
+            usage.total_token_count = 35
             mock_response.usage_metadata = usage
 
             mock_client_instance.aio.models.generate_content = AsyncMock(return_value=mock_response)
@@ -299,10 +300,10 @@ async def _test():
                     assert val == 10
                     has_input = True
                 elif name == "output tokens":
-                    assert val == 20
+                    assert val == 25  # candidates (20) + thoughts (5)
                     has_output = True
                 elif name == "total tokens":
-                    assert val == 30
+                    assert val == 35
                     has_total = True
 
             assert has_input and has_output and has_total
